span.p:
User-pref + Template DB
raat 2 baje offer SMS
-> pehle pasand dekho: SMS band = chhodo, raat 10-8 koi ghanti nahi
phir meri bhasha me saancha bharo, pasand + saancha cache me (preference + quiet hours)
shaanti me offer -> subah 8 baje bhejo (scheduled_at)
shaanti me OTP / login -> bhejo, zaroori upar
pasand badli -> cache delete + chhoti umar
